"'''The Tale of Short Spire / The Team Up'''" is the twenty-second episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''.<ref name="dgepress" /> It will be released on [[Disney+]] on [[February 14]], [[2024]].<ref name="Futon" />

==Official description==
''The Jedi investigate who is cutting down spires on Batuu. Taborr and the Jedi must work together.''
